correctness.rationale: The assigned final theorem concerns only Ind(GP(10,3)), not generalized Petersen graphs universally. Independently rebuilt all 6,211 nonempty independent faces with f-vector (20,160,660,1510,1924,1320,480,115,20,2) and exactly 3,102 staged matched covers. Independent orientation and topological sort visited all 6,211 faces and all 30,360 covers, proving acyclicity. Critical cells: one 0-cell, one 4-cell and five 5-cells. An independently implemented signed gradient-path recursion gives five zero integer Morse d5 coefficients. Forman's theorem yields a CW model with 4-skeleton S4 and degree-zero S4→S4 attaching maps; because π4(S4)=Z by degree, each 5-cell attaches trivially. Thus S4∨(∨5S5), not just mod-2 Betti numbers. Source verify.py blob 985267d23e7696083b171c26418770aabdc96b5c and its certificate.json were directly inspected. Bounded enumeration is exhaustive only for the specified 20-vertex graph.
